# iboats Boating Forums

> > Community forum for boat owners and enthusiasts covering outboard motors (Mercury, Yamaha, OMC), boat restoration, personal watercraft (PWC), and marine maintenance.

iboats Boating Forums is an active online community where boaters discuss engine troubleshooting, boat restoration projects, trailer maintenance, and equipment advice. The forums feature dedicated sections for major manufacturers like Mercury, Yamaha, Honda, and brands like Bayliner, Sea Ray, and Mastercraft.

## Key Topics

- Mercury & Mariner Outboards
- Yamaha Outboards
- OMC (Outboard Marine Corporation)
- Boat Maintenance & Troubleshooting
- Boat Restoration & Hull Repair
- Personal Watercraft (PWC)
- Pontoon Boats
- Force & Chrysler Outboards
- Boat Trailers & Guide-Ons
- Marine Engines
- Sea Ray
- Bayliner
- Honda Marine
- Sea-Doo & Waverunner
- Trolling Motors

- [Boating Forum - iboats Boating Forums](https://forums.iboats.com): Homepage for iboats Boating Forums community and discussion boards

- [Help | Boating Forum - iboats Boating Forums](https://forums.iboats.com/help): Help center with smilies, BB codes, trophies, and forum features
